info.title: Ticketing Public API
info.description: REST API for Ticketing as a Service. Follows REST industry-standard practices using GET, POST, and PUT methods. Responses are in reverse chronological order. Rate limit: 100 requests per 60 seconds.

get.description: Retrieve a list of tickets in reverse chronological order. Supports filtering, sorting, field selection, and pagination via limit/offset or continuationToken.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone offset of the caller, e.g. 7 means GMT+7.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page. Max 1000, default 10.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token from previous response to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Available: id, ticketId, title, description, status, requestor, customFields, priority, assignee, expectedDate, resolution, firstResponseOn, firstResolutionOn, lastResolutionOn, createdOn, tags, lastUpdatedOn, isFrtEscalated, isRtEscalated, createdBy, lastUpdatedBy, lastResolutionComment.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Filter tickets created after this datetime. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Filter tickets created before this datetime. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

parameters.name: expectedDateAfter
parameters.description: Filter by expected date after this datetime.

parameters.name: expectedDateBefore
parameters.description: Filter by expected date before this datetime.

parameters.name: lastUpdateAfter
parameters.description: Filter tickets last updated after this datetime.

parameters.name: lastUpdateBefore
parameters.description: Filter tickets last updated before this datetime.

continuationToken.description: Pass as header in next request to fetch the next page. Absent when no more pages.

get.description: Get list of attachments linked to a specific attachment activity. IMPORTANT: the activityId must be the value of item.activityId from the POST /tickets/{ticketId}/attachments response. Activity IDs from GET /tickets/{ticketId}/activities are not valid here — only attachment activities are supported, and passing a non-attachment activity ID will result in a 500 Internal error.

parameters.name: activityId
parameters.description: ID of the attachment activity. Must come from item.activityId in the POST /tickets/{ticketId}/attachments response.

apiKeyHeader.name: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: Primary or secondary API key from the Ticketing App settings.

apiKeyQuery.name: key
apiKeyQuery.description: API key passed as query parameter. Example: ?key={your_API_Key}&timezone=7

IUser.description: Represents a user (requestor, assignee, or acting user). For Microsoft 365 users, use the Azure Object ID, Display Name, and Email.

id.description: Azure Object ID or email (for email-to-ticket).

ITicket.description: A ticket object. Used both for write requests (create/update) and read responses. Custom field IDs can be found via GET /instance.

id.description: Internal UUID of the ticket. Present in responses.

ticketNo.description: Human-readable ticket number (e.g. 1839). Present in responses.

description.description:
Ticket description. Supports HTML formatting — use

for paragraphs,
for line breaks, for bold, for underline. Example:

Summary

Line 1
Line 2

expectedDate.description: Date only, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-04-01). IMPORTANT: using a datetime format (e.g. 2026-04-01T17:00:00Z) when customFields is also present causes a silent validation failure — the ticket is not created and no error message is returned.

customFields.description: Key-value pairs where key is the 36-character custom field ID. Value type depends on field type: string (text/date), boolean (toggle), array of strings (item picker), array of IUser (people picker).

lastUpdatedOn.description: Last update datetime. Present in responses.

resolvedStatus.description: Resolution type if resolved. Present in responses.

IAttachmentActivityResponse.description: Response body from POST /tickets/{ticketId}/attachments. Contains activityId which must be used with GET /tickets/activity/{activityId}/attachments.

activityId.description: ID of the created attachment activity. Use this with GET /tickets/activity/{activityId}/attachments.

IActivity.description: An activity on a ticket — either a status change or a comment.

ICustomField.description: Custom field definition as returned by GET /instance.

id.description: 36-character UUID used as the key in ticket customFields.

type.description: Field type: text, textarea, toggle, datepicker, peoplepicker, itempicker.
